note: Editorial attention direction (docs/ATTENTION.md): how the renderer guides the eye to meaning the lesson already authored. The planner never reads this file. A mode is derived from the current beat (src/attention/direction.ts); each mode names a visual hierarchy (the opacity of what is not the subject: 1 = untouched, never below the floor the loader enforces) and a bounded whole-world framing (a scale about the frame centre and a lean toward the subject, clamped so the world still covers the frame and every text stays title-safe; identity when it cannot). ESTABLISH and TRANSITION are always neutral and have no entry here. Pixels change with this file, so it is part of the build identity (src/manifest/build-identity.ts).

framing.note: Hard ceilings, derived from visual review: a 1.04 scale with the full coverage lean (38 x 22 px) pushed captions to the title-safe edge and split the header row for no gain in direction. The coverage rule (|tx| <= 960 (s - 1), |ty| <= 540 (s - 1)) and the title-safe rule still bind on top of these.

entrance.note: The one addition to the laid-brick settle: a route draws on from its source to its destination, so its direction is seen, not faded in.
